subject: Request: Evaluation Credits for RFP Bake-off / Acme AI
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.ai>
Date: 2026-02-24T15:12:00Z
Subject: Eval credits for our RFP bake-off?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We're running a three-week RFP bake-off comparing Redwood, VendorX, and CloudLlama. Procurement asked whether Redwood can provide evaluation credits (GPU credit pool + embeddings) to run our standard benchmark suite and customer prompts.

Key asks:
- ~500k tokens generation + 100k embeddings over 3 weeks
- Access to streaming + function calling for a subset of tests
- A short approved IP/usage note for our security team

Can you point me to the right contact to sign off? We'd like to include Redwood in the benchmark matrix this Monday.

Best,
Jordan
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme AI

Attachment: acme_rfp_requirements.pdf (pdf stub)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-24T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Eval credits for our RFP bake-off?

Jordan —

Appreciate the details and the timeline. We can absolutely support a benchmark pool for that scope, but I need internal approval for the promotional credit amount and a short security statement for your team. Looping in Stephanie (acct exec) and Rishi (solutions) — they will coordinate the test configuration.

Next steps:
- Stephanie: confirm commercial credit amount we can offer for a three-week bake-off.
- Rishi: who on your side should we whitelist/allow for function calling / streaming?
- Jordan: if you can share the security checklist items from your PDF, Rishi will prepare the usage language.

I'll track approvals and get back with a single credit terms spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-25T09:38:00Z
Subject: Re: Eval credits for our RFP bake-off? — proposed credit amount

Marissa, Rishi —

I've checked with pricing — we can offer a promotional credit equivalent to $12k USD (roughly 600k token-generation + 120k embeddings buffer) for this bake-off, with the following guardrails:
- Credit valid for 21 days from activation.
- No refunds; any overage billed at list (standard pay-as-you-go).
- We require a signed evaluation credit agreement for accounting (DocuSign) — attached a draft spreadsheet with the credit line and activation steps.

Vivek, marking for visibility in case we want to stretch this for a strategic account.

If legal needs to weigh in on the wording I'll route to Lauren.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive

Attachment: proposed-credit-terms-ACME.xlsx (xls stub)
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-25T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Eval credits — legal signoff notes

All —

Quick legal notes on the evaluation credit agreement:
1) Keep the usage clause narrow: credits only for non-production benchmarking; no resale.
2) Limit liability: standard evaluation terms, no SLA obligations while credits in effect.
3) Data security statement: we can provide the following short paragraph for Acme's security team: "Customer-provided prompts and outputs used for evaluation will be processed on Redwood-hosted inference with transient caching; logs retained per the Customer's selected retention policy and are accessible via audit logs on request."

I redlined the DocuSign template — sending back to Stephanie for signature flow.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.ai>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-26T14:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Eval credits for our RFP bake-off? — test config & IP note

Jordan / Samantha —

Thanks for the requirements doc. Quick answers:
- We'll provision a temporary project with an API key tied to the ACME-RFP project; please provide a list of tester emails to be whitelisted for streaming and function calling.
- For the security note Lauren provided: "Prompts and responses used for evaluation are processed on Redwood-hosted inference. KV cache and prefixes used for the benchmark will be ephemeral and cleared after the evaluation unless the customer requests retention. Audit logs can be exported on request for the evaluation period."

I attached a short runbook for the benchmark steps (warmup, canonical prompt set, metric tags) so your team can align with our telemetry. Let me know your whitelist and desired activation date.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachment: rfp-benchmark-runbook.txt (txt stub)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-03-02T18:45:00Z
Subject: Confirmed: ACME RFP eval credits activated

Jordan —

All set: we've issued a $12k promotional credit for the ACME-RFP project (Deal: ACME-RFP-2026). Credit is valid for 21 days from activation; your team will receive an invite to the Redwood Console and a temporary API key within the hour.

Links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-RFP-2026
- DocuSign (evaluation credit agreement): https://www.docusign.com/ACME/eval-credit-agreement

Next steps for you:
1) Sign the DocuSign evaluation credit agreement.
2) Send the list of tester emails to Rishi to whitelist streaming/function-calling.

If you want us to run the canonical benchmark and share a results artifact at the end, we can offer a one-hour analysis session once the bake-off completes.

Thanks for including Redwood in the bake-off — excited to see the results.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: activation-confirmation.txt (txt stub)
